messages.subject: Annotation error
parts:
Hi,
I am having the following error when I try to annotate the differentially methylated regions with the "annotateWithGeneParts" function. 

Specifically, the error is :

> gene.parts = readTranscriptFeatures("/rds/project/hgTables")
Reading the table...
Calculating intron coordinates...                                                                                  
Calculating exon coordinates...
Calculating TSS coordinates...
Calculating promoter coordinates...
Outputting the final GRangesList...

> load("myDiff.RData")
> load("myDiff25p.RData")
> annotateWithGeneParts(as(myDiff25p,"GRanges"),gene.parts)
 *** caught segfault ***
address (nil), cause 'unknown'

 *** caught segfault ***
address (nil), cause 'unknown'

Traceback:
 1: data.table::fread(file = filepath, ...)
 2: fread.gzipped(tbxFile, nrow = nrow, stringsAsFactors = FALSE,     data.table = returnDt, skip = length(Rsamtools::headerTabix(tbxFile)$header))
 3: headTabix(tbxFile = from@dbpath, nrow = fr...@num.records, return.type = "GRanges")
 4: asMethod(object)
 5: as(myDiff25p, "GRanges")
 6: annotateWithGeneParts(as(myDiff25p, "GRanges"), gene.parts)

Hg Table comes from UCSC, I would be very grateful if anyone could point me to the reason behind this error message.
Many thanks
Selma.

messages.author: ab8277113f65c05e
messages.subject: Re: [methylkit_discussion] Annotation error
parts:
I think this needs to be a bed12 file, regular hgTable structure might not work, please send a reproducible example if you can

best,
Altuna
